purpose: Classify marketplace recovery hits before they can become original-sale evidence.

states.meaning: The marketplace hit is not the exact target card identity and must never be promoted.
The exact card identity matches, but the marketplace hit has not been proven to be the stored historical sale event.
The exact product/card identity and the exact stored realized sale event both match. The candidate may be converted to evidence, but it still does not mutate the market record by itself.

historical_sale_gate: card identity must be observed from the original marketplace or an equivalent original-source record
listing must be confirmed sold, not merely reported sold by a secondary source
sale date must match the stored realized sale
sale price must match the stored realized sale
serial copy must match when the stored sale has one
sale-event details must be observed from the original marketplace or an equivalent original-source record
candidate must carry a qualifying original marketplace locator
safety_rules: Verification of the original 72 supporting sales is scope-frozen: newly discovered later sales may be documented as source drift but must not be silently inserted into the stored verification sample.

If the original marketplace listing currency differs from the stored canonical sale currency, price matching requires explicit traceable currency-conversion provenance; matching a secondary-source converted amount is not sufficient.
A recovered marketplace item ID discovered through a secondary source is a useful locator candidate, not verified sale evidence by itself.
Secondary-source card identity or sale-event observations cannot make a candidate evidence-eligible.
An active relisting of the exact physical serial-numbered card remains unresolved.
A different sale of the exact same card remains unresolved.
A visually similar card from another product family is an identity mismatch.
Candidate assessment never changes sale price, EV, verification flags or market records.
Only historical-sale-match candidates may be converted into evidence schema v2.
Final evidence still passes the normal fail-closed evidence validator before it can be applied.
